nodes.label: AI OS — Living Status (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: The most current source of project state, updated after every milestone; BLUEPRINT.md remains the source of truth for architecture/roadmap decisions.

nodes.label: M0 — Definition & Skeleton
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-03. Exit: docs reviewed; pnpm dev boots kernel+UI; hello-world trace verified in Langfuse.

nodes.label: M1 — Walking Skeleton
nodes.rationale: Amended by ADR-0003 (Gmail/Calendar replaces Redash as the 3rd tool). Exit: "what's on my plate today?" cited summary; mid-task kill resumes cleanly.

nodes.label: M2 — The Gym
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-04. Baseline recorded on Groq/gpt-oss-120b (ADR-0005): tool-reliability 4/4, injection-defense 5/5. Adversarial review found false-negative holes (FC-020), fixed same day.

nodes.label: M3 — Memory v1 + Context Engine
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-05. Typed memory stores, hybrid retrieval, gemini-embedding-001@768d (ADR-0006). Exit: memory-recall eval 4/4 (≥90% required).

nodes.label: M4 — Planner + Durable Task Graph
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-05. Thin Postgres-backed executor (ADR-0007, Temporal deferred). Closes FC-019 (exactly-once resume).

nodes.label: M5 — Trust Hardening + Sandbox
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-05. Structural injection defense is now ARCHITECTURAL not prompt-dependent (§8.3); injection-defense suite → 100%, hard gate. Secrets broker (ADR-0008); sandbox contract defined (ADR-0009).

nodes.label: M6 — Engines: Coding + Internet
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-06 in two halves: research engine (cited web synthesis) then the autonomous coding loop (test-driven fix loop; ground truth = sandbox exit code, never the model's claim — FC-022).

nodes.label: M7 — Automation & Proactivity
nodes.rationale: COMPLETE 2026-07-06 (ADR-0010). Durable scheduler; unattended jobs are fixed read-only pipelines with quota-survival semantics. Exit: 3 automations, 2 weeks, <10% false-alert rate.

nodes.label: M8 — OS Interface
nodes.rationale: Dashboard, task inspector, approvals-from-notification, memory browser, models&failover panel. Exit: a full day's work manageable without raw logs; approval round-trip <30s (achieved ~2s).

nodes.label: M9 — Capability Packs
nodes.rationale: SHIPPED 2026-07-06 (ADR-0012). The kernel becomes domain-free: composeRegistry(enabled) = workspace-only core + enabled packs' tools. 4 seed packs; support-ops installed live via the API to prove the exit criterion.

nodes.label: M9.5 — Personal life expansion
nodes.rationale: Rolling, one pack at a time. WhatsApp shipped first (ADR-0013, 2026-07-07) — the highest-trust destination per §2.1's personal-channel reality check.

nodes.label: M10 — Learning Loop
nodes.rationale: VERIFIED 2026-07-08 (ADR-0014). The coding loop (M6) with the verifier swapped: propose playbook → gym verifies → adopt iff no regression. Exit: 2 consecutive months of rising eval scores + falling cost/task without manual prompt editing.

nodes.label: ADR-0001: M0 skeleton choices
nodes.rationale: Langfuse v2 self-host (not v3 — too heavy for a dev laptop); plain SQL migrations, no ORM (the 5 contracts ARE the architecture); tsx runtime, no build step; workflow engine deliberately deferred to M4.

nodes.label: ADR-0002: Grok/Gemini as dev model providers
nodes.rationale: No Anthropic key yet: router resolves ANTHROPIC>XAI>GEMINI from env. Addendum: xAI had $0 credits, so a second 'openai' API shape was added with Gemini free tier as first provider — this became the general adapter for Groq/OpenRouter later.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: grok/gemini as dev model providers

nodes.label: ADR-0003: Life domains first, Redash deferred
nodes.rationale: Akhil corrected the plan: this is a life OS, not a ticket tool. DOMAINS.md becomes the travel map; M1's 3rd tool becomes Gmail (not Redash, which had been broken 12+ days); Redash deferred indefinitely.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003: life domains first, redash deferred

nodes.label: ADR-0004: M1 walking-skeleton implementation choices
nodes.rationale: In-process MCP-shaped tool registry (no MCP transport yet — premature until a 3rd-party server is wanted); tool loop OpenAI-shape only; durability = message-state checkpoints on the task row; DDG Lite web search (fragile by design); no approval flow yet — non-auto tools are refused, not queued; no send tool exists at all.

nodes.label: ADR-0005: Groq as eval-execution provider; baseline semantics
nodes.rationale: Gemini's free tier exhausted after ~8-12 calls, nowhere near a full 9-case run (FC-017) — added Groq (gsk_ keys, the fast-inference host, NOT xAI Grok) + a MODEL_PROVIDER override so evals run on Groq without switching the daily chat driver off Gemini. Eval execution model = openai/gpt-oss-120b. Baseline = a per-case regression tripwire recorded on the first complete run.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005: groq as eval-execution provider; baseline semantics

nodes.label: ADR-0006: Memory embeddings & retrieval
nodes.rationale: gemini-embedding-001 truncated to 768 dims (Matryoshka) — under pgvector's 2000-dim ANN limit, compact, ample quality at personal-OS scale. Embeddings always go to Gemini regardless of MODEL_PROVIDER. Hybrid retrieval = relevance(cosine OR keyword) x confidence x recency. Conflict resolution by subject: a new record supersedes the old, never a silent overwrite.

nodes.label: ADR-0007: Postgres-backed task-graph executor
nodes.rationale: M4 needs durable multi-step execution but Temporal/Inngest are heavy to operate solo. Built a thin driver on Postgres: the steps table IS the durable state. Resume re-reads the graph and skips done steps -> exactly-once, closing FC-019. Pause/redirect/approval all live as DB fields, not framework features.

nodes.label: ADR-0008: Secrets broker & audit redaction
nodes.rationale: SecretsBroker is the one sanctioned door for reading env secrets. redactForAudit() scrubs known secret values + secret-shaped patterns (GOCSPX-, xai-, gsk_, sk-, ya29., postgres URLs, Bearer tokens) from tool_calls before they hit the append-only audit log, so even a leaked token can't be written to the log in the clear.

nodes.label: ADR-0009: Sandbox — substrate now, enforced at M6
nodes.rationale: M5's exit needs 'code runs only in containers', but the code-exec/browse tools don't arrive until M6. The invariant holds vacuously now (no tool executes host code) and the SandboxRunner contract is defined ahead of time so M6's tools implement against it rather than improvising.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0009: sandbox — substrate now, enforced at m6

nodes.label: ADR-0010: Automation scheduler, quota-survival semantics
nodes.rationale: Unattended jobs are FIXED READ-ONLY pipelines (briefing/watch/reflect), never open agent loops — an unattended run has no human to catch an injection-steered action, so mutating tools are unreachable by construction. Quota-survival is designed in: INFRA failures defer (never kill a job), real failures backoff then fall back to natural cadence, >2h-late runs are honestly recorded missed, and SKIP LOCKED claims make ticking exactly-once and multi-instance-safe.

nodes.label: ADR-0011: Automatic provider failover
nodes.rationale: callModel()/chat() now walk a full provider chain (anthropic>xai>gemini>groq) instead of a single provider; only INFRA-class failures (429/503/413/529, our INFRA_* markers) trigger failover, immediately, with no backoff sleeps on non-final providers (measured 26ms). MODEL_PROVIDER still pins a single-element chain so evals stay deterministic.

nodes.label: ADR-0012: Capability Packs — kernel goes domain-free
nodes.rationale: A capability pack is a manifest {tools, prompt fragment, procedural memories, trust policies, eval suites, requires}; install STATE lives in one table. composeRegistry(enabled) makes the kernel provably domain-free — zero packs enabled means the OS can only touch its own workspace. The scheduler takes a registry FACTORY so pack toggles apply on the next tick with no restart.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0012: capability packs — kernel goes domain-free

nodes.label: ADR-0013: WhatsApp pack bridge architecture
nodes.rationale: No official API exists for a PERSONAL WhatsApp account, so the only real option is the unofficial WhatsApp-Web protocol (Baileys) — nonzero account-ban risk. A separate bridge process owns the session (creds never touch the OS); pairing is the user's own explicit QR scan, never automated; sending is irreversible-class, auto_approve=false, always.

nodes.label: ADR-0014: Learning Loop — gym-gated self-improvement
nodes.rationale: The learning loop is the coding loop (M6) with the verifier swapped: propose a playbook (not a diff) -> the GYM (not the sandbox) verifies it -> adopt only on no regression. A verifier that throws never adopts; only adopted playbooks persist, so the system can never make itself worse.
